title: Pyne Pod Blackberry Blackcurrant Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pyne Pod NicSalts Blackberry Blackcurrant 10ml E-Liquid delivers a deeply layered and vibrant dark fruit experience. This expertly formulated blend captures the bold, sweet essence of ripe Blackberry, providing a smooth and juicy foundation on the inhale. To balance this richness, a sharp, tart note of fresh Blackcurrant emerges on the exhale, creating a highly satisfying contrast that makes this an endlessly satisfying flavour to vape throughout the day. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. Pyne Pod Nic Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Pyne Pod Nic Salts collection translates the intense, highly popular flavours of their renowned prefilled pods into a versatile 10ml format. Offering a more cost-effective and flexible alternative, the range covers a wide variety of tastes. Beyond the dark fruit fusion of Blackberry Blackcurrant, vapers can explore other irresistible blends such as the sweet nostalgia of Blue Razz GB, the tropical notes of Fruit Punch, or the frosty chill of Pomegranate Ice.
